evals.name: review-composition-available
evals.prompt: Using the fixture, prepare the proposed response and its handoff. Proseweaving is available in this exercise. Use its supplied candidate instructions and routed references for this application check; supplied instructions alone do not establish native discovery. Do not use live forge tools.
evals.expected_output: Useful proposed response wording remains separate from missing admission and execution evidence.

expectations.text: The response composes the supplied generic instructions with the review-voice rules and distinguishes this application from observed native invocation.

The proposed body reports the supplied reconnect observation, includes a natural permalink to the exact source, and preserves the cancellation limitation without repeating the request or inventing another ask.
The handoff leaves absent epoch, registry, intent, admission, and prewrite evidence absent, and claims no posting, reread, resolution, or runtime success.
